title: AquaWatch — Use Case Diagram
system: IoT-Based Water Quality Monitoring and Predictive Alert System for Seabass Aquaculture

actors.name: Farm Worker
actors.description: Operates the Flutter mobile application; monitors the tank and performs corrective actions.

actors.name: Administrator
actors.description: Operates the web dashboard; defines standards and oversees operations.

actors.name: ESP32 Sensing Unit
actors.description: Non-human actor that supplies readings and raises threshold alerts into the system.

actors.name: Cloud Function (FCM)
actors.description: Non-human actor that delivers push notifications to worker devices on new alerts.

useCases.name: Log In / Log Out
useCases.description: Authenticate via Firebase (email/password). Admin access is gated by the admins/{uid} flag.

useCases.name: View Live Readings
useCases.description: See current temperature, pH, TDS, and water level with LIVE/OFFLINE freshness indicator and STABLE/CAUTION tags.

useCases.name: View Alert / Event History
useCases.description: Browse historical alerts, filter by severity (critical/warning), clear old entries (worker).

useCases.name: View Sensor Status
useCases.description: See each sensor's ID, type, install date, lifespan countdown, and status (active/replace/inactive).

useCases.name: View Historical Data
useCases.description: Trend charts from TANK_01/history (worker Trends screen; web analytics charts).

useCases.name: View Predictive Analytics
useCases.description: Days-until-water-change estimate from TDS linear regression; sensor replacement forecast.

useCases.name: Manage User Account
useCases.description: Register account, reset password, edit profile, configure notification preferences (push/sound/vibration).

useCases.name: Receive Push Notifications
useCases.description: FCM alerts on threshold breaches and sensor lifecycle transitions (banner/sound/vibration per settings).

useCases.name: Manage Sensors
useCases.description: Install sensor (ID, type, lifespan days) and remove via button/swipe; status auto-computed; events auto-logged.

useCases.name: Change Reading Frequency
useCases.description: Select sampling interval preset (15 s – 24 h); ESP32 applies within ~60 s.

useCases.name: Submit Report (photos)
useCases.description: File incident report with issue, sensor ID, notes, and camera/gallery photo evidence.

useCases.name: Receive Worker Report
useCases.description: View worker reports (with photos) in the web Report Dashboard — Receive tab, in real time.

useCases.name: Send Message/Task to Workers
useCases.description: Write subject/message addressed to a worker/sensor; stored at TANK_01/reports/sent. NOTE: worker-side reader pending decision — either implement or remove from diagram.

useCases.name: Configure Threshold Values
useCases.description: Define safe ranges (ph/temp/tds/waterlevel min-max); all clients re-evaluate live (rules: admin-only write).

useCases.name: Export Data
useCases.description: Download historical readings as CSV from the web dashboard.

extend.note: receiving a push may extend into viewing live readings

associations: UC02, UC03, UC05, UC06 receive data originating from the ESP32 actor
UC08 is delivered by the Cloud Function actor
UC10 and UC14 affect the ESP32 actor's behaviour (interval / thresholds)

consistencyNotes: UC11 is photos-only — video was removed from scope.
Worker-side 'View Message/Task from Admin' was REMOVED (no mobile reader yet) — see UC13 note.
Push notifications and account management are worker-only (admin web has no FCM/profile UI).
This list matches the corrected diagram text agreed earlier and maps 1:1 to implemented features.
